metadata.title: How To Make Persian Lamb Koobideh Kebab
metadata.description:
WELCOME TO HENRYS HOWTOS
I am a fulltime self trained executive chef as well as having alot of experience and knowledge in DIY, electronics, trades & home improvements. I shared and like to help everyone on my channel with my videos, If you have any suggestions or would like any help, feel free to shoot through a message or post a comment. New videos weekly! PLEASE SUBSCRIBE!
SUBSCRIBE: http://www.youtube.com/user/henrytad1990?sub_confirmation=1
YOUTUBE: http://www.youtube.com/henrytad1990
FACEBOOK: http://www.facebook.com/henry.tadevosian

How to make Persian koobideh kebab recipe and how to skewer it. An icon of Persian cuisine!

5kg lamb shoulder 
1kg onion
1 tbsp Paprika
1 tbsp Turmeric
2 tbsp Salt
1 tsp Pepper
2 tbsp Red Sumac (Quantity based on personal preference)

nodes.plm_caption:
In the foreground, there are vegetables being prepared. The camera then zooms out to show a man cutting up beef for grinding. The camera then goes back to the man, showing him using a meat grinder, putting spices into a bowl, and mixing all the ingredients together. Finally, the camera goes to the meat mixing bowl to show the final product. This video is set in a professional kitchen. In the background, there are stainless steel cupboards and shelves with some products on it. There is a clock on the countertop. The person in the video is wearing a black shirt. The video is well lit with natural lighting.
The video starts by showing a silver bowl with whole vegetables in it. Then it zooms to the left and reveals a stainless steel bowl with some seasonings in it, also zooming to the left reveals a person chopping vegetables in a professional kitchen. The camera zooms down again, and we see the person putting the chopped vegetables through a vegetable grinder. Then it changes focus and we see a large piece of beef, partially exposed, being cut into pieces. The person then moves on to the meat grinder, which is located to the right, as the camera moves back up. At this time the person is also seen using a knife to cut through the meat that is coming out of the grinder. The person then cuts the meat and puts it into a big white bowl. The camera then moves back up and we see the person start mixing all the ingredients in the same bowl. The bowl is put through a food processor, then the camera pans to the right to see the finished product.
The person in this video is wearing a black shirt and is standing up, facing the camera, with their head visible at the top of the frame. Throughout the video, the person is actively engaged in cooking. The kitchen in the video appears professional with stainless steel cupboards and shelves with various items on them. The clock is on the countertop, and the lighting is natural. The person is standing in front of a countertop, while in the background, there is a weighing machine visible, along with the silver cabinets and cabinets on the wall.

summary.brief: A man grinds lamb with onion juice and spices, mixes the blend, and shapes it onto kebab skewers.
summary.detailed: The video begins with whole onions that are halved, chopped and run through a food processor, separating the onion juice which is set aside. A lamb shoulder is trimmed of bone, cut into small pieces and fed through an electric meat grinder twice to produce a fine mince. The ground lamb is placed in a large white bowl, where the onion juice and a mixture of paprika, turmeric, salt, pepper, red sumac and saffron are added and mixed thoroughly by hand. After a final pass through the grinder for consistency, the seasoned meat is scooped with a large blade onto a long metal skewer, the skewer is rotated to display the layers and any meat that sticks to the blade is removed with the hand. The completed kebab skewer is then placed into a clear plastic container. Throughout, the man wears a black shirt and works at a stainless‑steel professional kitchen counter with a clock and other equipment visible.

action.detailed: Grind the lamb shoulder, mix the ground meat with onion juice and spices in a large bowl, run the mixture through the grinder again, scoop the seasoned meat onto a long metal skewer, rotate the skewer to arrange the meat while removing any pieces that stick, and place the finished skewer in a container.
action.actor: a man wearing a black shirt

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a man preparing food in a kitchen. He is cutting onions, preparing meat, and using a grinder.  The video has a speed-up effect and the lighting is bright. The camera is handheld and moves around.
The man is wearing a black shirt while working in the kitchen. He first cuts the onions by hand and then feeds them into a food processor. He then cuts the meat and prepares it before adding it into the grinder.  He removes the ground meat from the grinder and checks its quality, before combining it with the onion and beef in a big white bowl and mixing them all with the other ingredients he used to make the food.
The man can be seen moving between the food processor, the table and then the mixer. The mixer is used to grind the meat, and then the man removes the ground meat from it into a white bowl. The person uses both hands to remove the ground meat and then adds more meat into the mixer until he removes it again. He mixes all of the ingredients together and then pushes them in a bowl with his left hand.

summary.brief: A man in a black shirt chops onions, grinds lamb shoulder, and mixes the ground meat with onion puree, spices, mashed potatoes and gravy to create a kebab filling.
summary.detailed: The video begins with a man in a black shirt chopping whole onions on a stainless‑steel countertop and feeding the pieces into a food processor to puree them. He then cuts a lamb shoulder into small chunks, loads the pieces into an industrial‑style meat grinder, and collects the minced meat in a white bowl, repeating the grinding several times and adding more raw meat each pass. After the meat is ground, he pours the onion puree into the bowl, adds visible spices and seasonings, and mixes the blend by hand and with a spoon. A bowl of mashed potatoes and brown gravy is then introduced; he folds these into the seasoned meat mixture and stirs until a uniform kebab mixture is achieved.

action.detailed: Grind the meat, combine it with onion puree, spices, mashed potatoes and gravy, and stir everything thoroughly in a bowl.
action.actor: A man wearing a black shirt

nodes.plm_caption:
A video of a kitchen scene was shot.
In the beginning of the video, the focus is on a person's hand using a large blade to scoop ground meat. Then the focus shifts to a knife with more meat on the handle, a wire attached to the blade, the person taking it off a skewer and putting it back on.

The video was shot in the kitchen, with multiple silver equipment visible in the background, along with some bottles of ingredients. A transparent plastic container is also visible on the foreground.

summary.brief: The chef finishes grinding meat into a bowl, then extrudes it onto a metal skewer, trims and cuts it, and stores the finished skewer in a clear container.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with an electric meat grinder dispensing freshly ground red meat into a white bowl on a stainless‑steel countertop while the chef, a man in a black shirt, operates the machine. He continues to push the mixture through the grinder, which produces a long rope‑like strand of meat that winds around a metal skewer. Holding the skewer upright, he rotates it to display the layers, removes stray pieces that cling to the metal with his fingers, and cuts the wrapped meat into even sections. Finally, he places the completed skewer into a transparent plastic storage bin. Throughout, stainless‑steel kitchen equipment, a clock, and a few bottles are visible in the background.

action.brief: Grind meat and shape onto skewer
action.detailed: Grind the meat with the electric grinder into a bowl, then push it through to form a long rope onto a metal skewer, rotate the skewer to show the meat, remove any stuck fragments with your fingers, cut the meat into uniform pieces, and place the skewer into a clear plastic container.
action.actor: A male chef wearing a black shirt

nodes.plm_caption:
The video features a sped-up shot of someone cooking in a restaurant kitchen. The camera captures the chef preparing a variety of ingredients and cooking them on a flat top stove. The scene is set against a backdrop of restaurant equipment and utensils.
There are two raw beef shanks covered in plastic wrap resting on top of a white cutting board, and a bunch of raw onions. A bowl contains all the seasonings and spices needed for cooking. The camera shows a young man wearing a black T-shirt and striped pants, cutting the onions into thin slices and putting them into a blender to puree. A basket below the blender has a pile of the blended onions inside. Then, the same man takes out all of the wrapped meat on the counter, removes the plastic wrap, and begins cutting it with a knife on the cutting board. The video ends with a wide shot of the cut pieces of meat in a white bowl.
On the right side of the frame, there is a tall container with yellow sauce or dressing inside. In the background, there are shelves with bowls stacked neatly. The walls are white, and a stainless steel vent is over the stove.

summary.brief: A chef chops onions, purees them, then unwraps and dices raw beef, placing the meat pieces in a bowl.
summary.detailed: The clip opens on a stainless‑steel countertop displaying several bowls: whole onions, a bowl of dry spices, a tall container of pale‑yellow liquid, and two plastic‑wrapped beef shanks. A young man in a black T‑shirt and striped pants picks up the onions, slices them on a cutting board and feeds the slices into a food‑processor/blender, collecting the resulting onion puree in a basket below. After the onions are processed, he removes the plastic from the beef shanks, trims away excess fat and cuts the meat into many small cubes with a large knife, then transfers the diced meat to a white bowl. The segment ends with a wide shot of the bowl filled with the chopped meat while the background shows kitchen shelves, a yellow‑sauce container, a stainless‑steel vent and other appliances.

action.detailed: Slice the onions, puree them in the blender, unwrap the beef, trim and cut the meat into small pieces, and place the diced meat into a bowl.
action.actor: a young man in a black T‑shirt and striped pants

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a meat grinder. A person picks up small pieces of raw meat from a bowl and feeds the meat through a meat grinder. Once the meat is ground, it is mixed with a pan of ground potatoes and spices. The mixture is placed on top of the bowl of ground meat as the man mixes them together.

summary.brief: The chef repeatedly feeds raw beef into a grinder and then blends the ground meat with seasonings and mashed potatoes.
summary.detailed: A man wearing a black shirt works at a stainless‑steel countertop. He picks up handfuls of raw red beef from a white bowl and pushes the pieces into a metal electric grinder; the freshly minced meat drops into a second white collection bowl. He repeats this feeding and grinding several times, filling the bowl with ground beef. After enough ground meat is gathered, he adds visible seasonings – dark red seasoning, orange powder, oil and other spices – together with a bowl of mashed potatoes. Using a spoon and his left hand, he folds and stirs the ingredients until they form a uniform reddish‑brown mixture. The background shows a microwave, glass containers and other kitchen utensils.

action.detailed: Feed raw beef pieces into the grinder, collect the ground meat in a bowl, then add spices and mashed potatoes and stir thoroughly with a spoon and hand.
action.actor: A man in a black shirt operating the meat grinder and mixing the ingredients

nodes.plm_caption: Grounded meat is being prepared in a bowl.

summary.brief: Ground meat is expelled from a grinder into a white bowl.
summary.detailed: A hand operates an electric meat grinder on a stainless‑steel countertop; as the grinder runs, raw red meat is forced through the metal auger and drops into a white bowl positioned directly beneath it. The close‑up, top‑down view shows a steady flow of minced meat filling the bowl while a dark countertop, a microwave and a folded napkin are visible in the background.

action.detailed: Operate the electric meat grinder to force the raw meat through the auger and dispense it into the white bowl below.
action.actor: The cook’s hand

nodes.plm_caption: The video captures a man preparing food in a kitchen. He uses a meat grinder machine, then prepares a long skewer of meat. He carefully removes pieces of meat that stick to the metal skewer with his bare hand while he turns the meat from one end to another. The man gives instructions for how to prepare the food.

summary.brief: The chef runs a meat grinder, forms the extruded meat onto a skewer, trims it, and places the skewer in a clear bin.
summary.detailed: The man in the black shirt operates the meat grinder, forcing ground lamb through the machine so that long ropes of meat collect in a bowl. He then arranges these meat strands onto a long metal skewer, rotating the skewer while using his bare hand to pull off any pieces that stick. After trimming the meat with a knife into even sections, he steadies the skewer and drops it into a clear plastic storage bin.

action.detailed: Run the grinder to extrude meat strands, wrap them onto a metal skewer, rotate the skewer while removing any stuck pieces with your hand, cut the meat into even pieces with a knife, and place the finished skewer into a clear plastic bin.
action.actor: the chef wearing a black shirt

nodes.plm_caption:
The video is a recording of various ingredients and tools on a countertop. There is a stainless steel bowl with whole unpeeled onions in it, a tall container with a pale yellow colored liquid in it, a metal bowl with different spices in it and three unpeeled large red meats in clear bags. The video zooms into each of the items before zooming out to show them all together.
The video is clear and well lit. The onions are all unpeeled, the meat is raw, the spices are dry and there is nothing else in the shot besides these items on the countertop.
The ingredients are well lit and a great selection of ingredients for the cooking activity being done. The video could be a how-to video for cooking a certain recipe.

summary.brief: Halved onions, a pale‑yellow liquid, a spice bowl and wrapped meat are displayed, then a carrot is added, salt and spices are sprinkled, and a piece of meat is moved onto a board.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a stainless‑steel bowl holding halved onions that slowly rotates on a countertop; next to it stands a tall container of pale‑yellow liquid and a metal bowl filled with dry spices, while three pieces of raw red meat are visible in clear plastic bags. The camera zooms briefly onto each item and then pulls back to show them together. A hand then places a carrot into the spice/salt bowl, follows by sprinkling salt and additional spices from a spoon, and finally repositions one wrapped piece of meat onto a white cutting board. The view ends with all the ingredients arranged on the counter.

action.detailed: Place a carrot into the spice bowl, sprinkle salt and other spices into the bowl with a spoon, and reposition a wrapped piece of meat onto a cutting board.
action.actor: the chef (a person in a black shirt)

nodes.plm_caption:
In this video, a chef is seen prepping meat and vegetables for cooking. The chef starts by slicing up two onions before putting them into a juicer. After juicing the onions, he removes the cooked onions from the juicer into a bowl. Then he goes to a large piece of beef or pork and begins to cut up the meat, again into a bowl.

The background shows a professional kitchen with a stainless steel counter top. The chef wears a black t-shirt. The kitchen is well-lit, and there are a few items visible in the background, including a red plastic crate, a microwave, a bread basket, and various containers.

summary.brief: The chef chops onions, juices them, then trims and dices a slab of raw meat.
summary.detailed: In a bright professional kitchen, a man wearing a black T‑shirt slices several onions on a white cutting board while a large stainless‑steel bowl sits nearby. The cut onion pieces are placed into a countertop juicer, which extracts their liquid into a bowl. After the onion preparation, the chef unwraps a large piece of raw meat, removes excess fat, and uses a long‑handled knife to cut the meat into many small pieces, stacking the pieces before depositing the diced meat into another bowl. The background shows stainless‑steel countertops, a red plastic crate, a microwave, a bread basket and assorted containers.

action.detailed: Chop the onions, run the chopped pieces through the juicer to collect the extracted liquid, then unwrap the meat, trim off fat, and cut the meat into small pieces before placing the pieces into a bowl.
action.actor: the chef wearing a black T‑shirt

nodes.plm_caption:
A man places a piece of beef into a meat grinder, extrudes minced beef into a white bowl, and grabs another piece of beef. It goes back into the grinder. He then grabs some ground beef and drops it back into the bowl and grabs another piece of beef to grind. The man then grabs a spoon and begins to combine the ground beef with the ungrounded beef in the bowl.
The video is shot in a room with silver surfaces. The man is wearing no gloves and is using an industrial meat grinder. There are two white bowls, and a silver glass, and a microwave in the background.

summary.brief: A man fills an industrial grinder with raw beef, collects the minced meat in a bowl, and then mixes it with the remaining chunks.
summary.detailed: The video shows a man wearing a black shirt working at a stainless‑steel countertop. He first tosses thinly sliced raw beef in a white bowl with his left hand, moving the pieces around. He then picks up individual pieces of the beef and pushes them into the funnel of an industrial meat grinder, using his bare hand. The grinder is turned and the minced meat falls into a second white bowl placed directly beneath it. He repeats this process several times, adding more raw pieces and grinding them. After a sufficient amount of meat is ground, he grabs a spoon and stirs the freshly minced meat together with the remaining unground chunks, creating a uniform mixture. In the background a microwave, a glass container and other kitchen items can be seen on the silver‑colored surfaces.

action.detailed: Place pieces of raw beef into the grinder, operate the grinder to mince the meat into the bowl, repeat with additional pieces, then stir the ground meat together with the remaining chunks using a spoon.
action.actor: the man wearing a black shirt

nodes.plm_caption:
A large bowl full of raw ground beef. Several seasoning are added and mixed in, then the bowl of ground beef is mixed with the seasoning. It is all taken from a home kitchen, the ingredients are all mixed and the bowl is white with two handles on either side.
The man is showing how the mixing process works. The ground beef is first dropped into the bowl.
A couple of different seasoning added to the bowl, and then mixed into the bowl of ground beef. The ground beef is then dropped into the meat grinder, it comes out the other side and is mixed in.
The ground beef, spices and other ingredients are shown being mixed together in a bowl.
A hand mixer, or spoon, is used to mix up everything in the bowl. The bowl is on the kitchen counter.
A white cutting board with the same mix on it.

summary.brief: The cook seasons raw ground meat, runs it through a grinder, then folds in mashed potatoes and sauce, stirring everything together.
summary.detailed: A large white bowl holding raw ground meat sits on the countertop. The cook adds several dry seasonings (and a touch of oil) and stirs the mixture with a spoon and his hand. He then feeds the seasoned meat into an electric meat grinder, letting the pinkish strands fall back into the same bowl and runs the grinder a second time for a finer texture. After grinding, he adds a bowl of mashed potatoes and a brown sauce with additional seasonings, and vigorously mixes the combined ingredients with the spoon and his hand until a uniform, well‑combined mixture is achieved.

action.brief: mix seasoned ground meat with other ingredients
action.detailed: Add the spices and oil to the bowl of raw ground meat, stir with a spoon and hand, guide the meat through the electric grinder and collect the output back into the bowl, then incorporate the mashed potatoes and brown sauce, stirring vigorously with the spoon and hand until everything is evenly combined.
action.actor: the man in the black shirt

nodes.plm_action: Grind meat in a stainless steel bowl using a meat grinder
nodes.plm_caption: It shows a meat grinder which is grinding meat into smaller pieces. The meat is initially in a white bowl and being mixed by a human hand in the left of the frame, then drops into a grinder which sits in the right of the frame. There are other objects visible in the background, including a microwave oven, paper towels, and a bottle. The light in the scene is very bright, and very still.

The video shows the initial moment of a person using an electric meat grinder, where the resulting ground meat is being pushed downward into a white plastic bowl. It is a very close-up video, with an unframed shot from directly above, where the contents of the meat grinder are overflowing onto the bowl. The scene is set on a stainless steel countertop.

summary.brief: An electric meat grinder pushes freshly ground meat into a white bowl on a stainless‑steel countertop.
summary.detailed: A close‑up, top‑down view shows an electric meat grinder with its feed opening turned to the side. As the grinder runs, raw red meat is forced through the metal auger and exits as finely ground pieces that fall directly into a white round bowl positioned beneath it. The meat builds up in a small pile, with occasional bits spilling over the bowl’s edge. The countertop is stainless steel, and a microwave and a white napkin are faintly visible to the right, but the focus remains on the grinding action.

action.detailed: Operate the grinder so that the meat is forced through the auger, ground, and drops into the bowl below.
action.actor: The person operating the grinder (off‑screen)

nodes.plm_action: Mash the meat with a potato masher.
nodes.plm_caption: The video features a chef using a meat grinder. There is a large clear plastic bin in the foreground, and the kitchen is all stainless steel. The man in the black t-shirt is wearing a gold chain. There is a weight scale in the background. It appears to be in a well-lit, modern kitchen.

summary.brief: The chef runs the meat grinder, the minced meat streams out as strands, which he gathers and mixes in a bowl.
summary.detailed: A male chef wearing a black shirt and a gold chain stands at a stainless‑steel countertop with a clear plastic bin and a scale visible behind him. He activates a meat grinder; the minced lamb emerges as long ropes that fall onto the work surface and form a small pile. He reaches in, scoops the strands with his hands, transfers them into a bowl, and mixes the meat to combine it evenly.

action.detailed: Run the meat grinder to extrude strands of minced meat, scoop the strands with your hands, and stir them together in the bowl.
action.actor: The male chef wearing a black shirt and a gold chain

nodes.plm_caption: This video shows a man with a large metal skewer of meat in a commercial kitchen. He holds the metal skewer upright, but it is more like a sharpening rod and he has an unkeined knife lying on the end. He rotates the rod to display the different cuts of meat stacked on it. After completing the video, he places the skewer in a clear plastic storage bin.

summary.brief: The chef twirls a meat‑skewered rod, shows the wrapped meat, and drops it into a clear plastic bin.
summary.detailed: In a bright commercial kitchen, a man wearing a black t‑shirt first picks up a large chef’s knife, rubs its wooden handle, and runs a finger along the blade to demonstrate its edge. He then lifts a long metal rod that has strips of raw meat wound around it, using the knife to help tighten and shape the spiral. He rotates the skewer, showing the layers of meat from all angles, and briefly inserts the knife into the end of the rod to adjust the wrap. Finally, he steadies the assembled skewer and lowers it into a clear plastic storage container.

action.brief: Rotate meat skewer; place in container
action.detailed: Hold the meat‑skewered rod, turn it to display the wrapped meat, then lower and set it into the clear plastic bin.
action.actor: the chef wearing a black t‑shirt

nodes.plm_caption:
It shows a metal bowl with onions cut in half. They are different shades of green and light yellow, in various states of ripeness. The bowl is sitting on a metal counter.
The bowl is slightly rotating, showing all sides of the onions. There is a cut, which is showing the inside. A part of a liquid container is on the right of the bowl.

summary.brief: A stainless‑steel bowl of halved onions rotates on a metal countertop while a voice gives tips about onions.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a metal bowl resting on a stainless‑steel counter; inside are five peeled onions that have been cut lengthwise, showing their white interiors and varying green‑yellow shades. The bowl is slowly turned, revealing the onions from all sides. A red‑colored liquid container is visible on the right edge of the frame. Throughout, an off‑camera narrator speaks, advising how to choose fresh white onions, how long they soften, and how to store them in a jar or refrigerator.

action.detailed: Rotate the bowl of five lengthwise‑cut onions to display them from all sides as a narrator discusses selecting fresh white onions and their storage.
action.actor: N/A

nodes.plm_action: Use the flavorings and seasonings of your choice.
nodes.plm_caption: In the background there are three bowl of ingredients. One has salt, one with an onion in it and one with a yellow liquid in it. Three pieces of meat wrapped up. A person puts a carrot in the bowl of salt and spices. A hand holding a carrot. The three bowls of ingredients with different ingredients in each. The salt, the onion, the spices, and the meat all being prepared to cook. The meat all being wrapped up.

summary.brief: A hand drops a carrot and measured spices into a bowl while raw meat pieces in plastic are shown nearby.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with three stainless‑steel bowls on a countertop: peeled onions in the left bowl, a bowl of salt and mixed spices in the centre, and a clear container of yellow liquid on the right. A hand picks up a carrot and places it into the central spice bowl. The same hand then adds teaspoons of salt, paprika and cumin, sprinkling the powders into the bowl as they settle. The camera then shifts to show three pieces of raw meat wrapped in transparent plastic; one piece is lifted and positioned on a white cutting board while the other pieces remain in their bags.

action.detailed: Place a carrot into the spice bowl, then spoon teaspoons of salt, paprika and cumin into the same bowl, and finally move the wrapped raw meat pieces onto a cutting board.
action.actor: the chef’s hand

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a person chopping up white turnips in  big pieces to put into a metal bowl.

summary.brief: A man in a black shirt rapidly chops onions on a cutting board beside a metal bowl.
summary.detailed: In a bright kitchen, a man wearing a black shirt and dark jeans stands at a white countertop. He places a peeled white onion (and later a few slices of yam) on a cutting board next to a large stainless‑steel bowl. Using a large chef’s knife held in his right hand, he repeatedly slices the onion with a quick back‑and‑forth motion while his left hand steadies the vegetable. The chopped pieces fall into or near the bowl, which he nudges aside briefly before continuing. The segment ends with a fast‑motion glimpse of him handling additional sliced onion and yam pieces near a blender.

action.detailed: Chop the onion by holding it with the left hand, slicing it repeatedly with a large knife on the cutting board, and letting the pieces fall into the nearby metal bowl.
action.actor: The man wearing a black shirt and dark jeans

nodes.plm_caption:

summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video begins with whole onions that are halved, chopped and run through a food processor, separating the onion juice which is set aside. A lamb shoulder is trimmed of bone, cut into small pieces and fed through an electric meat grinder twice to produce a fine mince. The ground lamb is placed in a large white bowl, where the onion juice and a mixture of paprika, turmeric, salt, pepper, red sumac and saffron are added and mixed thoroughly by hand. After a final pass through the grinder for consistency, the seasoned meat is scooped with a large blade onto a long metal skewer, the skewer is rotated to display the layers and any meat that sticks to the blade is removed with the hand. The completed kebab skewer is then placed into a clear plastic container. Throughout, the man wears a black shirt and works at a stainless‑steel professional kitchen counter with a clock and other equipment visible.

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to any of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an
     agent traverses space — first-person walking tours (museum, store,
     home, city street), driving / cycling / hiking POV footage, drone
     fly-throughs of indoor or outdoor scenes, room/house walkthroughs.
     The camera's translation through the environment IS the main content.
     Does NOT count: a stationary tripod with someone talking; a tutorial
     filmed in one place; b-roll where the camera only pans or zooms but
     does not translate; sports footage where the player moves but the
     camera stays put.
   A video can match zero, one, or multiple domains. Be strict — when in
   doubt, say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
